  2. Make 1 cyan dye from a white wool.
  
- **Step 3:** Make white wool using 4 strings.

5. Craft 3 cyan beds using 3 cyan dyes (crafted) and 3 white wool (crafted).
6. Gather and use the 3 cyan beds crafted earlier to form a cyan bed.

This completes the strategy, allowing us to craft a cyan bed.
